fullDescription: A neo-brutalist pricing page on a warm cream canvas with hard-shadowed cards, a 3-tier layout, a monthly/annual toggle, and a bold Archivo Black display face.

structured.summary: A frameless, responsive neo-brutalist SaaS pricing page on a warm cream (#f4ecd8) canvas with a faint grid texture. Thick 2px black outlines and hard offset drop shadows give every element a sticker-like, tactile feel. The core is a 3-tier pricing card row (Starter / Pro / Studio) with the middle Pro tier highlighted in mustard yellow, lifted, and badged 'Most popular'. A pill billing toggle (Monthly/Annual, Save 20%) swaps the displayed price and suffix live. Below sits an accordion FAQ and a dark inverted footer. Display type is the heavy Archivo Black; body is Space Grotesk; prices and meta use DM Mono.

style.description: Warm, playful neo-brutalism: a cream/paper background, chunky 2px ink-black borders on everything, hard (non-blurred) offset shadows, generously rounded card corners, and a tight accent palette of mustard yellow, grape purple, mint, and coral. Loud display headline with a highlighter-marker swipe, monospace prices, and scattered decorative star/sparkle doodles with their own hard drop-shadows. Friendly and confident, never sterile.
style.prompt: Build a warm neo-brutalist visual style. Background canvas is cream #f4ecd8 overlaid with a faint 26px square grid (lines at rgba(26,23,20,0.05)). Core ink color #1a1714 (near-black) used for all text and the 2px borders that outline every card, button, badge, icon tile, and toggle. Two off-white surfaces: paper #fffdf6 (cards, buttons) and ground #f4ecd8 (FAQ rows, icon wells). Accent palette: pop mustard #ffc83d (highlighted tier, logo tile, marker highlight, active toggle), popdeep #ffb000, grape #7c5cff (links/hover + studio icon tile), mint #4ad6a0 (save badge, trust line icon), coral #ff6b5e (decorative + FAQ badge icon). Signature shadows are HARD and un-blurred, offset toward bottom-right in ink: hardsm 4px 4px 0 #1a1714, hard 6px 6px 0 #1a1714, hardlg 9px 9px 0 #1a1714. Corners: cards rounded-2xl, buttons/icon-tiles/FAQ rounded-xl, badges/toggle fully pill. Fonts: display = 'Archivo Black' (headlines, prices, tier names, logo), body/UI = 'Space Grotesk' (paragraphs, feature lists, labels), mono = 'DM Mono' (price suffixes like /month, copyright). Hover interactions lift elements up (translateY -2 to -4px) and deepen the hard shadow. Use Phosphor-style line/fill icons in matching weights.

layout_and_structure.description: A single frameless, responsive web page, max-width ~1152px (max-w-6xl) centered, stacked top to bottom: sticky bordered nav, a grid-textured hero+pricing section (badge, big headline, subcopy, billing toggle, the 3-card pricing row, trust line), a centered accordion FAQ on a paper surface, and a dark inverted footer. The pricing cards are the centerpiece and reflow 3 -> 2 -> 1 column as the viewport narrows.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top nav (z-50) on a translucent cream bar (bg-ground/95 + backdrop-blur) with a 2px ink bottom border, height ~64px, inside the max-w-6xl container. Left: logo lockup = a 36px rounded-md mustard tile with 2px border and a small hard shadow holding a bolt icon, next to the 'Promptkit' wordmark in Archivo Black. Center (hidden on mobile): nav links Library / Templates / Pricing / FAQ in Space Grotesk medium, with the current page link colored grape and others hovering to grape. Right: a 'Log in' text link plus a primary 'Start free' button (solid ink fill, paper text, 2px border, small hard shadow, arrow icon) that lifts on hover.

A centered hero on the grid-textured cream section. Top: a small pill eyebrow badge (paper fill, 2px border, hard shadow, uppercase tracked text 'Simple, honest pricing' with a grape palette icon). Below: a large Archivo Black headline ~clamp(2.25rem -> 3.75rem) reading 'Ship UI From a Single Prompt' where the phrase 'Single Prompt' gets a mustard highlighter-marker swipe (a linear-gradient background painting only the lower ~32% of the text like a highlighter). Under it, a max-w-md muted subparagraph (ink at 70% opacity) describing a curated library of design prompts. Optional: a few decorative star/sparkle doodles absolutely positioned around the hero on large screens, each in an accent color with its own hard drop-shadow and a slight rotation.

A centered, flex-wrapping toggle row above the cards: bold 'Monthly' label, then a custom pill switch (72px wide, 2px ink border, paper track, hard shadow) with a 24px mustard knob that slides ~34px right and flips the track to mustard when annual is on; then a 'Annual' label (dimmed to ink/45 when inactive); then a mint 'Save 20%' pill badge with a tag icon and 2px border. Wire it as an accessible switch (role=switch, aria-checked). Toggling updates every price number (data-monthly / data-annual) and the price suffix ('/month' -> '/mo billed yearly') live via JS.

A responsive pricing grid that is 1 column on mobile, 2 columns on md, and 3 columns on lg (grid-cols-1 / md:grid-cols-2 / lg:grid-cols-3), items aligned to top, gap-6. Three tiers as flex-column cards: STARTER and STUDIO are paper-fill with a 2px ink border and the medium hard shadow; the middle PRO tier is the highlight, filled mustard #ffc83d with the largest hard shadow (hardlg), nudged up and out (lg:-mt-4 lg:mb-4), and carrying an absolutely-positioned 'Most popular' badge (ink pill, paper text, mustard star icon) centered on its top edge. Each card structure top-to-bottom: a 48px rounded-xl bordered icon tile (Starter pennib on ground, Pro rocket on paper, Studio buildings icon in paper on a grape tile), tier name in Archivo Black, a one-line muted descriptor, then the price block = a big Archivo Black price (~text-5xl, e.g. $0 / $24 / $69) baseline-aligned with a DM Mono suffix (/forever, /month). Then a feature list where each row is a 20px rounded-full bordered check chip + Space Grotesk label (e.g. '25 prompts / month', 'Unlimited prompts', 'Coding-agent skill access', 'Up to 10 seats', 'SSO & dedicated support'). Card CTA pinned at the bottom: Starter = paper outline button 'Get started free', Pro = solid ink button 'Start 14-day trial' with arrow, Studio = paper outline 'Talk to us'. All cards lift and deepen their shadow on hover. Below the grid, a centered muted trust line with a mint shield icon: 'No credit card to start. Cancel anytime, no hard feelings.'

A centered FAQ section on a solid paper surface separated by a 2px ink top border, max-w-3xl. Header: a small pill badge (ground fill, 2px border, hard shadow, uppercase 'Good to know' with a coral question icon) above an Archivo Black 'Questions, answered' heading. Then a vertical stack of native <details> accordion rows, each a rounded-xl ground-fill card with a 2px border and small hard shadow; the summary is a bold question in a flex row with a plus icon that rotates 45deg into an x when open; the answer is muted ink/70 body text. Seed ~4 questions (what a prompt is, switching plans, ownership of output, refund/cancel) with the first one open by default.

A dark inverted footer: solid ink #1a1714 background, paper text, 2px ink top border, inside max-w-6xl. A row that stacks on mobile and spreads on sm+: left the logo lockup (mustard bolt tile with a paper 2px border + wordmark in Archivo Black), center a wrap of muted footer links (Library / Changelog / Docs / FAQ / Privacy) that hover to mustard, and right a DM Mono copyright line at low opacity.

special_ui_components.description: Every card, button, badge and tile uses a 2px ink border plus a hard, un-blurred offset shadow to look like a physical sticker; hover lifts the element and deepens the shadow.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define three hard shadow tokens (4/4, 6/6, 9/9 px offsets, 0 blur, color #1a1714). Apply a 2px solid #1a1714 border + the medium shadow to default cards, the large shadow to the highlighted tier, and the small shadow to buttons/badges/tiles. On hover, translateY by -2 to -4px and swap to the next shadow size up for a tactile 'press out of the page' effect.

special_ui_components.description: An accessible pill switch that animates a knob, recolors the track, and rewrites all prices + suffixes between monthly and annual values, paired with a 'Save 20%' badge.
special_ui_components.prompt: Custom switch: role=switch + aria-checked, 2px-bordered pill track with a hard-shadowed circular knob. On toggle, animate the knob translateX, flip track and knob fill between paper and mustard, dim the inactive label, and update each price element from its data-monthly/data-annual attributes plus swap the suffix text ('/month' <-> '/mo billed yearly').

special_ui_components.description: The middle pricing card is visually elevated: mustard fill, largest hard shadow, vertically offset above its neighbors, and topped by an ink ribbon badge.
special_ui_components.prompt: Give the recommended tier the pop mustard fill (#ffc83d), the largest hard shadow, and a negative top margin + positive bottom margin on large screens so it sits proud of the other two cards. Pin an absolutely-positioned pill badge centered on its top edge: ink fill, paper uppercase text, mustard star icon, 2px border, small hard shadow.

special_ui_components.description: A key phrase in the hero headline is swiped with a mustard highlighter background that paints only the lower portion of the text.
special_ui_components.prompt: Wrap the emphasis phrase in a span with a linear-gradient background that is transparent for the top ~60% and mustard #ffc83d from ~60% to ~92%, with small horizontal padding, so it reads like a real highlighter stroke behind the words.

special_ui_components.description: All icons are Phosphor-style SVGs injected inline from a small JS map (data-ic name + data-sz size), so the page has no icon-font/network dependency.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use a small JS icon registry keyed by name (bolt, arrow, star, sparkle, check, rocket, buildings, shield, plus, etc.) and replace any element carrying a data-ic attribute with an inline 256x256 viewBox SVG at the requested data-sz size, inheriting currentColor.

structured.special_notes: This is a FRAMELESS, fully responsive web page (no device chrome): the centered max-w-6xl container fluidly fills the viewport, the nav stays sticky, and the pricing cards reflow from 3 columns to 2 to 1 as width drops. The transferable value is the warm neo-brutalist look (cream canvas + grid texture, 2px ink borders, hard offset shadows, mustard/grape/mint/coral accents, Archivo Black + Space Grotesk + DM Mono) combined with the proven pricing STRUCTURE: 3 tiers with the middle one highlighted, a live monthly/annual toggle with a savings badge, per-tier feature checklists, a trust line, and an accordion FAQ. No em-dashes in copy. All accents and prices are easy to swap for any SaaS or dev-tool brand.
